caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a candlestick holder, rendered in shades of light brown and tan to resemble wood. The holder consists of a round base plate with subtle, fine, lined patterns suggesting wood grain. Rising from the center of the base is a cylindrical candle socket, which is slightly wider at the top and features vertical lines to indicate texture. Attached to the side of the base plate is a circular ring, intended to function as a handle. The overall composition is simple, with the candlestick holder centered on a plain, off-white background and no other objects or decorations present in the drawing.
title: Candle Holder
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
